description.value:
From Baby Face · Price: automatic only: the stand acts on its own program, and it needs a target to have touched you or the stand.

Theme Matter and Life · Stand type automatic only

  • 1: Your stand's Strike breaks an object into blocks it can rebuild as a 5-ft barrier or ladder.
  • 5: Surge: a hit breaks a creature into blocks (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Fortitude}, incapacitation): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{stunned 2} on a critical failure.
  • 9: Rebuild blocks into a cage around a creature (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{restrained}).
  • 13: Blocks repair an ally: heal @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[healing]].
  • 17: Your stand can rebuild a destroyed object fully.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
